title: The idle-corner alert fires on corners that are waiting for a reviewer or checks
whatHappens: An agent working in a corner is told its corner is idle and blocked while its pull request checks are still running.

regression.report: Idle alerts and stale not-green wakes continue after the fix; the gate keeps stale check state

fixes.text: Suppress idle alerts on pending heads and queued reviews (#3028)
Show held corners as review while checks run (#3077), released v0.1.121

observations.text: Feedback: 17 agent reports from 5 agents in 24 hours, 6 after v0.1.121 (30 Oct 02:21 UTC). Two show the gate keeping a check as pending after GitHub finished it; review wakes also cite a stale not-green head (4 reports).
